Truncation: a reply that hit the token ceiling was stored as a finished document. It is now retried on a doubled budget and, failing that, refused with a named reason — nothing half-written is saved.

Three of the five research modules read only the first text block with no empty check; a run could finish missing research. All now go through one checked helper that fails loudly.

items: fillProductTab: reads the doc with includeTabsContent, finds the tab whose title starts with the run's product code (recursing into child tabs — the doc groups tabs under READY FOR LAUNCH / TO TEST), locates each template label row (BADGE TEXT, SUPPORTING SENTENCE, BENEFIT SECTION, FAQ cells, SECTION 1-3, Headline/Primary Text/Description, ONE LINERS) and inserts the copy into the empty cell of the row below.
Inserts sorted descending by index so earlier writes can't shift later targets; every request carries the explicit tabId (tabless requests would silently hit the doc's first tab).
Never overwrites: non-empty cells are skipped and reported (already-filled), so re-sends fill gaps only. insertText remains the only request type that can pass the non-destructive assertion.
No matching tab -> actionable error naming the exact tab title to create, plus the list of existing tabs. No product code -> tells the operator to set one on the run.

title: password gate, SSRF hardening, Google Doc export, Shopify fill v2
items: proxy.ts + lib/auth.ts: every page and API route now requires a session. Stateless HMAC cookie keyed off PIPELINE_PASSWORD (rotating the password is global logout), httpOnly/lax/30d with sliding renewal, timing-safe comparisons, per-IP + global login rate limits, Sec-Fetch-Site check on mutations, X-Robots-Tag on everything. FAIL CLOSED: unset password = 503 naming the fix (never a redirect loop). Pages redirect to /login; /api/* gets JSON 401; AuthWatch sends any 401'd fetch to the login page.
